title: Irish strike action to disrupt U.S. meat exports
summary:
Meat plants have been told not to make any products for export to the United States because of strike action in Ireland.

Industrial action by public sector workers is planned on Oct. 14 for 24 hours. A second strike is scheduled for Oct. 21. The dispute is related to wages.

title: Mixed picture of Salmonella in UK animals and pet food
summary:
Salmonella was detected more often in chickens but less frequently in pigs and raw meat-based pet food in 2025, according to the latest figures.

The Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) collected data on Salmonella from animals, feeding stuff and animal by-products (ABP) in England, Wales and Scotland.

title: Kebab shop owners convicted in fatal Salmonella case
summary:
The owners of a kebab restaurant in Austria have been convicted of hygiene offences in a case involving the death of a man infected by Salmonella.

A 63-year-old man died in June 2023 and had eaten a kebab from the takeaway before falling sick with Salmonella sepsis.
